1981-2415-2921-3845.description:
Activate Bartolomé del Presidio by sacrificing a creature
When the creature dies, Panicked Bystander // Cackling Culprit and Havoc Jester trigger.
Resolve the Panicked Bystander // Cackling Culprit trigger, causing you to gain 1 life
Resolve the Havoc Jester trigger, dealing 1 damage to you.
Darien triggers, creating a 1/1 Soldier creature token.
Resolve the Bartolomé del Presidio ability, putting a +1/+1 counter on them.
Repeat.

573-6798-6871-7115--44.description:
Cast the artifact by paying {0}.
Toph, Hardheaded Teacher triggers, earthbending Gruul Turf.
Resolve the artifact spell.
Activate Umbral Collar Zealot by sacrificing Gruul Turf.
When Gruul Turf dies, Toph, Hardheaded Teach triggers, returning Gruul Turf from your graveyard to the battlefield tapped.
When Gruul Turf enters, it triggers, returning the artifact cast in step 1 from the battlefield to your hand, as it's a land due to Toph, the First Metalbender.
Resolve the Umbral Collar Zealot ability
Repeat.

3147-6628-7857.description:
Activate PuPu UFO by tapping it, putting Azorius Chancery from your hand onto the battlefield.
When Azorius Chancery enters the battlefield, it and Elven Raft-Steerer trigger.
Resolve the Azorius Chancery trigger, returning itself from the battlefield to your hand.
Resolve the Elven Raft-Steerer trigger, untapping PuPu UFO.
Repeat.

uses.battlefieldCardState: attached to any other creature you control

206-3259-5982.notablePrerequisites: At least one opponent cannot block creatures you control.
206-3259-5982.description:
Deal combat damage using the creature that has Breath of Fury attached and Ancient Gold Dragon, triggering Breath of Fury and Ancient Gold Dragon.
Resolve the Ancient Gold Dragon trigger, creating at least one creature token.
Resolve the Breath of Fury trigger, causing you to sacrifice the creature it is attached to, then attach Breath of Fury to a creature token, then causing you to untap all creatures you control and to get an additional combat phase after this one. 
Repeat each combat phase.

728-2577-4549.description:
Activate Relic of Legends's last ability by tapping Grimgrin, adding {B}.
Activate Grimgrin by sacrificing Gravecrawler, untapping Grimgrin and putting a +1/+1 counter on it.
Cast Gravecrawler from your graveyard by paying {B}.
Repeat.

4549-4629-7124.description:
Declare The Incredible Hulk as an attacker.
Holding priority, activate Pyrohemia by paying {R}, dealing 1 damage to each creature and each player.
The Incredible Hulk triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on it, untapping it and giving you an additional combat phase after this one.
Holding priority, activate Relic of Legends' second ability by tapping The Incredible Hulk, adding {R}.
Repeat from step 2.

uses.n: Yarus, Roar of the Old Gods

2292-5434-5555-7046.notablePrerequisites: You control a face-down creature whose front face is a permanent card.
2292-5434-5555-7046.description:
Donate Karlov Watchdog to an opponent.
During the opponent's turn, activate Viscera Seer by sacrificing a face-down creature you control.
When the creature dies, Yarus's second ability triggers, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield face-down as a 2/2 creature, and then not turning it face-up due to Karlov Watchdog.
Resolve the Viscera Seer ability.
Repeat from step 2.

1482-2511-2866-4986.description:
Cast Jeweled Lotus by paying its mana cost.
Teshar triggers, returning Scrap Trawler from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Activate Jeweled Lotus by tapping and sacrificing it.
Activate Bloodflow Connoisseur by sacrificing Scrap Trawler.
When Scrap Trawler dies, it triggers, returning Jeweled Lotus from your graveyard to your hand.
Resolve the Bloodflow Connoisseur ability.
Repeat.

1387-1500-2100-2633-4146.description:
Cast Searing Touch with buyback by paying {R}. Urabrask, Blood Funnel and Murmuring Mystic trigger.
Resolve the Urabrask trigger, adding {R} and dealing 1 damage to any target.
Resolve the Murmuring Mystic trigger, creating a creature token.
Resolve the Blood Funnel trigger, causing you to sacrifice the creature token.
Resolve the Searing Touch spell.
Repeat.

338-3197-6720.easyPrerequisites: You have a way to gain life.
338-3197-6720.description:
Gain life.
Light of Promise triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on Herd Baloth.
Herd Baloth triggers, creating a creature token.
When the creature token enters the battlefield, Case of the Uneaten Feast triggers, causing you to gain 1 life.
Repeat from step 2.

1491-4050-4702-6667.description:
Activate Loporrit Scout by tapping it, creating a creature token.
When the creature token enters the battlefield, Loporrit Scout triggers, giving Loporrit Scout +1/+1 until end of turn.
Acitvate Loporrit Scout by paying {1} and putting a -1/-1 counter on it, untapping it.
Activate Phyrexian Altar by sacrificing the creature token, adding {1}.
Repeat.

2511-2730-6553.easyPrerequisites: Kaya's Ghostform attached to Brotherhood Outcast.
2511-2730-6553.description:
Activate Bloodflow Connoisseur by sacrificing Brotherhood Outcast.
When Brotherhood Outcast dies, Kaya's Ghostform triggers, returning Brotherhood Outcast from your graveyard to the battlefield.
When Brotherhood Outcast enters the battlefield, it triggers, returning Kaya's Ghostform from your graveyard to the battlefield attached to Brotherhood Outcast.
Resolve the Bloodflow Connoisseur ability.
Repeat.

964-2793-6248.description:
Cast Ugin's Nexus by paying {5}.
When Ugin's Nexus enters the battlefield, Replication Specialist triggers, causing you to pay {1}{U} to create a token copy of Ugin's Nexus.
Put the token Ugin's Nexus into exile due to the legend rule and the token's replacement effect, causing you to take an extra turn after this one.
At the beginning of your end step, Phenomenon Investigators triggers, returning Ugin's Nexus from the battlefield to your hand and causing you to draw a card.
Repeat during each of your turns.

1575-4826-5903.manaNeeded: {2} if you don't control a Treasure
1575-4826-5903.notablePrerequisites: You control at least one other artifact.
1575-4826-5903.description:
If you control a Treasure, activate it by sacrificing it, adding one mana of any color. If you don't control a Treasure, activate another artifact by paying {2}, tapping and sacrificing it.
Nuka-Cola Vending Machine triggers, creating a Treasure token that is also a Food due to Gourmand's Talent and that enters untapped due to Arcehlos.
Repeat.

requires.n: Artifact / Creature with "{T}: Add Mana" that can tap upon ETB (Mana Rock)

1170-1456-5078--30.description:
Activate Sensei's Divining Top's second ability by tapping it, causing you to draw a card and put Sensei's Divining Top from the battlefield on top of your library.
Activate the mana-producing artifact or creature by tapping it, adding at least {1}.
Cast Sensei's Divining Top from the top of your library by paying {1}.
Displacer Kitten triggers, blinking the mana-producing artifact or creature.
Repeat.

618-1379-1558-3866.description:
Activate Kiki-Jiki by tapping it, creating a token copy of Abhorrent Overlord with haste.
When the Abhorrent Overlord token enters the battlefield, it triggers, creating at least four 1/1 Harpy creature tokens.
Activate Time Sieve by tapping it, sacrificing the Abhorrent Overlord token and the Harpy tokens, causing you to take an extra turn after this one.
Repeat each turn.

371-647-5003.notablePrerequisites: You control at least five Forests.
371-647-5003.description:
Activate five Forests by tapping them, adding {G}{G}{G}{G}{G}.
Activate Llanowar Druid by tapping and sacrificing it.
Llanowar Druid dies, triggering Nim Deathmantle, causing you to pay {4} to return Llanowar Druid from your graveyard to the battlefield, and attach Nim Deathmantle to it.
Resolve the Llanowar Druid ability from step 2, untapping all Forests.
Repeat.

2232-2937-4848.notablePrerequisites: You control at least seven creatures.
2232-2937-4848.description:
Activate Xenagos's first ability by putting a loyalty counter on it, adding at least {3}{R}{R}{G}{G}.
Cast Domri by paying {1}{R}{G}.
Domri enters the battlefield, triggering Cloudstone Curio, returning Xenagos from the battlefield to your hand.
Activate Domri's first ability by putting a loyalty counter on it, adding {R/G}.
Cast Xenagos by paying {2}{R}{G}.
Xenagos enters the battlefield, triggering Cloudstone Curio, returning Domri from the battlefield to your hand.
Repeat.
Once you have infinite mana, you may instead activate Xenagos' second ability to get infinite creature tokens.

1818-1981-4591-4740.notablePrerequisites: Your life total is at least fifty.
1818-1981-4591-4740.description:
Activate Aetherflux Resevoir by paying fifty life, dealing fifty damage to yourself.
Darien triggers, creating fifty 1/1 Soldier creature tokens.
The Soldiers enter the battlefield, triggering Healer of the Pride fifty times, gaining you 100 life.
Repeat.

1812-2440-4770.notablePrerequisites: You control at least three Cat creatures.
1812-2440-4770.description:
Cast Whitemane Lion by paying {1}{W}.
When Whitemane Lion enters the battlefield, it triggers itself and Mana Echoes.
Resolve the Mana Echoes trigger, adding at least {C}{C}{C}{C}.
Resolve Whitemane Lion's trigger, returning itself from the battlefield to your hand.
Activate Prismite by paying {2}, adding {W}.
Repeat any number of times.
Once you have infinite colorless mana, you may activate Prismite any number of times.

65-717-875-2628-5181.description:
Activate Fetid Pools's cycling ability by paying {0} and discarding it.
Bone Miser, Fetid Pools, and Escape Protocol trigger.
Resolve the Bone Miser trigger, adding {B}{B}.
Resolve the Fetid Pools trigger, drawing a card.
Resolve the Escape Protocol trigger, causing you to pay {1} to blink Golgari Findbroker.
Golgari Findbroker enters the battlefield, returning Fetid Pools from your graveyard to your hand.
Repeat.
